question: How can the universe be the own-nature of one who is both beyond and consisting of the universe?
premises: The supreme is beyond the universe.
The supreme consists of the universe.
The universe is identified as that own-nature.
inference: The universe is the own-nature of the supreme who both transcends and comprises it.
plain_english: For you, the supreme who are beyond the universe and yet consist of the universe, that universe is your own nature.
